title.en: The Electric 20 Order Line Uses Every Printed Cell
title.zh: 电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 20 as 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. The order repeats that line.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20印成 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。订单重复这一行。

h1.en: Paste the Electric 20 Cells, Then Add Your Site Facts
h1.zh: 先粘贴电动20的格子，再写你的现场事实

directAnswer.en: To order the Electric 20 from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, the purchase line is the printed line: 22 kW motor, output 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, frame 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, weight 900 kg. There is one distance pair, not a fine-stone row and an aggregate row. Voltage is not on this sheet. Add your site voltage and frequency, your measured metres and your stone, and send [/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/) to the contact page. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动20，采购行就是印出的那一行：电机 22 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、重量 900 kg。只有一组距离，没有细石行和骨料行之分。这一页没有电压。请加上现场电压和频率、你量到的米数和石子，并把 [/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/) 发到询盘页。没有印价格。

heading.en: Why this page and not Electric 15
heading.zh: 为什么是这一页而不是电动15

body.en: Electric 15 prints 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, pipe 100–125 mm and 450 kg, and it does not print 80 mm or 10 MPa. Own 80 mm pipe points at Electric 20’s printed diameter, not at Electric 15.
body.zh: 电动15印 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、管径 100–125 mm、450 kg，并且不印 80 mm 或 10 MPa。已有 80 mm 管，对的是电动20印出的管径，不是电动15。

body.en: Maximum aggregate if it differs from 1–2 cm, the metres you measured, country and purchase timing. Do not change 8–10 into 20.
body.zh: 如果最大骨料不是 1–2 cm，请写上；还有你量到的米数、国家和采购时间。不要把 8–10 改成 20。

body.en: Ask Xingtai on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). The 900 kg figure is weight, not a price.
body.zh: 在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 问邢台。900 kg 是重量，不是价格。

answer.en: The label is H / V, so 120 m is horizontal and 40 m is vertical.
answer.zh: 标题是 H / V，因此 120 m 是水平，40 m 是垂直。

question.en: Is the hopper 0.25 m³ shared with the tractor page?
question.zh: 0.25 m³ 料斗和拖拉机页相同吗？

answer.en: The number matches Tractor-Driven 4100’s hopper. The machines do not.
answer.zh: 数字与拖拉机带动4100的料斗相同。机器不同。
